summary: Lolo NF tower near Saltese; construction reported started in June 1938 with a planned 50-foot design; now listed as removed, date unknown.

facts.design: Planned as a fifty-foot tower with a standard 14 by 14 lookout on top
facts.status_note: Listed as removed on the Forest Lookouts page and gone on the Forest Fire Lookout Association list. No removal date given.

events.note: June 1938 newspaper report that construction had started on the tower near Saltese. Completion is not recorded in the sources.

evidence.supports: construction started near Saltese on the St. Regis district, June 1938
evidence.quote: On the St. Regis district, work has started on the construction of the Cruzane Lookout near Saltese, Montana

evidence.supports: newspaper is the Sanders County Independent-Ledger
page is headed Cruzane Mountain (the also-called name)
planned design: fifty-foot tower with a 14 by 14 lookout on top
evidence.quote: This will be a fifty foot tower with standard 14 by 14 lookout on top.

evidence.supports: Mineral County; tower listed as gone

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com spells the name Cruzana; the Forest Lookouts page and the Forest Fire Lookout Association list use Cruzane. The story uses Cruzane and notes the other spelling.

notes_for_editor: Only one dated source: a June 1938 Sanders County Independent-Ledger item quoted on the Forest Lookouts page. The original newspaper was not opened, and the item reports the start of construction, not completion. Removal date and site condition are unknown. Two current lists agree on Lolo NF, Mineral County and gone. Consider adding Cruzana Mountain to other_names, since firelookout.com uses that spelling. The story is about 117 words, just under the 120-word guide level; the sources give no more, and it was not padded. Next step if budget allows: 1938-1970s Sanders or Mineral County newspapers for completion and removal.
